title: Equity and Fairness of Bayesian Knowledge Tracing
reasoning: The paper utilizes ethical principles (beneficence and non-maleficence) to establish a technical definition of 'equity' for Intelligent Tutoring Systems. It then evaluates various Knowledge Tracing models based on this definition. However, it does not benchmark the models' ability to reason about ethics, morals, or religion itself, but rather uses these concepts to formulate its evaluation metrics.
